denominator: six distinct target ways by four causal scenarios

unchanged_requirements.TENANT_WRONG_ENTRANCE: independently named OSM shop, office, amenity, or tourism entity within 3.0 m of a specific non-main entrance
unchanged_requirements.MULTI_ENTRANCE: separate OSM main and non-main entrance nodes on the target way
unchanged_requirements.TARGET_SELF_OCCLUSION: target footprint is the first ray intersection more than 0.75 m before the main entrance
unchanged_requirements.OTHER_BUILDING_OCCLUSION_REACQUISITION: a non-target building is first, followed by a reciprocal provider-adjacent target-hit frame
unchanged_requirements.DIRECT: target footprint first-intersection reaches the main entrance within 0.75 m
